title: One top bar everywhere
summary: Every page now shares the same top bar, and filters on the Materials page are easier to see and nicer to use.

changes.text: The scanner, Materials and release notes pages share one top bar that stays in place when you switch pages.
Home and Materials links sit in one glass pill, like the scanner tabs, with a highlight that slides to the page you open.
Settings and theme buttons match the new glass style.
Selected rarity and category filters fill with colour, so it's clear what's applied.
The Reset button slides in smoothly instead of jumping, and the filter cards give a small wiggle when filters change.
